quality_assessment: Excellent documentation with comprehensive visual explanations, accurate technical content, and practical examples. The page has been significantly enhanced since previous analysis with outstanding Mermaid diagrams, code annotations, and MkDocs Material features. Minor enhancement opportunities exist for covering PCRE2-specific edge cases and fixed-length vs variable-length lookbehind distinctions.

issues.description: Documentation mentions fixed-length vs variable-length lookbehind performance but doesn't explain the distinction or provide examples
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a subsection explaining that PCRE2 supports both fixed-length (e.g., (?<=foo)) and variable-length (e.g., (?<=foo.*)) lookbehind, with fixed-length being significantly faster. Include examples of each type.

issues.description: Mentions 'nested lookaround assertions' to avoid but doesn't provide an example or explain why they're problematic
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a brief example of nested lookaround (e.g., '(?=(?!...))') and explain that nested lookaround can cause exponential backtracking in PCRE2's backtracking engine.

issues.description: No example showing combined lookahead and lookbehind in a single pattern, despite mentioning 'Combine both' in the decision diagram
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an example combining both lookahead and lookbehind, such as: 'rg -Po "(?<=<title>).*(?=</title>)" # Extract text between HTML title tags'
